Group rides in Reno, NV

3 recurring group rides around Reno, NV: 2 road, 1 social, 1 mixed. 2 roll on weeknights, 1 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Bike Night Reno in Reno. Want to go fast? Reno Wheelmen Wednesday Group Ride runs b ~18 mph, C ~15 mph, faster riders self-organize.
